answer: The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The atlas lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the thread is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the sable of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
